sentences.text: and Registrar's Orders.
Mr. A.J. Mirza, Advocate for appellant.
Ms Sonia Thakur, Agp for respondent Nos.1 and 2.

Mr. T.M. Zaheer, Advocate for respondent No.3.
 CORAM : G.A. SANAP, J.
This is an application for condonation of 811 days delay caused in filing appeal against impugned judgment and award, dated 26.09.2017 passed by the Civil Judge (Sr. Dn.) Yavatmal.
The reasons have been stated in the application.
In view of the reasons, the application is allowed.
3. Delay of 811 days caused in filing the appeal stands condoned.

4. It is made clear that in view of the decision in the case of New Okhla Industrial Development 2 32 caf 1620.22.odt..odt Authority Vs. Rameshwar @ Ramesh Chandra Sharma (Dead), through Legal Heir and another (2022 SCC Online SC 1599), the original land owners/ claimants/appellants herein shall not be entitled to get any statutory benefits, including the interest payable under the Land Acquisition Act on the enhanced amount of compensation for the delayed period, in case the appeal is allowed.
5. The appeal be registered.
